basic_info.description: This large 1 bedroom + den condo in a boutique Pacific Heights building is the perfect blend of classic charm with modern influence. Nestled on a high floor at the quiet rear of the building, this space offers a peaceful retreat with all the perks of city living right outside your door. Step inside to find period details - hardwood floors, crown moldings, and high ceilings that bring warmth and character to the space. The light-filled living room is a breath of fresh air, offering tranquil green outlooks, making it the ultimate place to relax and unwind. Adjacent to the living room, a sleek office nook provides the perfect work-from-home setup. The eat-in kitchen offers top-of-the-line appliances and plenty of space to cook, dine, and entertain. The generous bedroom is a true sanctuary, featuring a walk-in closet big enough for all your wardrobe dreams. The remodeled bathroom is sleek and stylish, with modern finishes that make every day feel like a spa day. With ample closet space and additional storage, staying organized has never been easier. Live in one of San Francisco's most coveted neighborhoods, offering incredible walkability, public transit, parks, and just moments from the best cafs, boutiques, and restaurants on nearby Sacramento & Fillmore streets.
